editorial:
Ever had a parent who just wouldn't stop nagging you about your love life? Now imagine a mom who takes that to a scary level. You get to meet Mrs. Sethi, an Indian mother whose only goal in life is to find the perfect husband for her daughter. The problem is that her obsession gets so intense that it actually turns murderous. It is a wild ride that blends a family drama with a dark comedy vibe. At first, the jokes feel a bit off and some of the physical comedy is kind of cringey, but you will find yourself sucked into the chaos anyway.

The acting is the real glue that holds this mess together, making the crazy plot feel almost believable. While the pacing jumps around and some scenes feel too long, the twists keep you guessing until the end. If you like movies that are weird and a little mean, you should definitely give this one a shot. You can grab it by renting it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical shelf is a great way to keep the quality high.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the ghosts of the people Mrs. Sethi killed start haunting her. You see her finally face the consequences of her actions in a chaotic final confrontation. The twist is that the daughter finally finds her own voice and stands up to her mother. In the end, the spirits find peace, and Mrs. Sethi is stopped from ruining any more lives, leaving the daughter free to live on her own terms.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark humor and family chaos.
